topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecture opens with introductory remarks on the course structure, audience, and core learning objectives.

topics.label: Cellular differentiation failure, tissue architecture, and culture models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how genetic and epigenetic changes disrupt normal tissue differentiation and examine the methods and limitations of modeling this process in culture.

topics.label: Benign and malignant tumour progression, classification, and morbidity
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the biological and clinical distinctions between benign and malignant tumours, covering invasive growth, metastasis, stepwise progression, standard nomenclature, and mechanisms of patient morbidity.

topics.label: Tumour incidence across humans and other animal species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the patterns and mortality of tumour occurrence in human populations and compare cancer incidence across diverse multicellular animal species.

topics.label: Cancer screening methods and clinical detection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the principles, diagnostic techniques, and practical limitations of population screening programmes for various cancer types.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and practical reminders
topics.groupedBecause: The lecture closes with a wrap-up referring back to the learning outcomes and reminders for upcoming practicals.
